what: Merging main into the lane conflicted in start-host.ts and broke the typecheck: main's unused-export sweep dropped the export of HostStart, MAX_SOCKET_PATH and Caps, which the lane's laws and projects.tsx import. After the merge, pnpm lint fails on four lane exports the new dead-code check finds: Palette and PaletteSource in window/frame.ts, platform in project.test-support.ts, and settingsFile in host/settings.ts called only from tests.
cause: The lane sat on a main from early 2026-11-09 while main gained the dead-export check.
fix: The lead's merge keeps the three exports. The four findings go to build (frame.ts, settings.ts) and tests (project.test-support.ts).
test: pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint on the merged head.
